notes.title: Update OCT 2021
notes.notes:
25-10-2021
SORRY for the delay, so may problems to overcome! :)
But, my GPU is not resting a moment and to use the time I am rendering animations. I'll try even 24 hours per day rendering, if possible, else around 10-12 hours.
Thank you for understanding 


The development of the game is continuing with full power. Sadly I started working on 2 massive episodes on the same time, trying to speed up the process and I ended up with incompletes renders or waiting for voices.
Next update in OCT and final update by DEC.

Visit patreon to vote next side stories and explore unique renders related to the story.

Challenges that makes the development slower:

 multiple characters to render (up to 20 characters in ep04/ep05 to pose)
 detailed mansion built and furnished based on story
 relationship building in ep04/ep05 and NPC reaction
